semantics.approach: world xyz_m displacement from measured entry, contact profile; stall is not a contact certificate
semantics.completion: only measured pose arrival or measured gap stability; object/task success remains unknown
semantics.continuation: submit a new execution from the current observation; relative targets use new measured entry poses
semantics.gripper: motion keeps the actual command; use separate set_gripper with null pose fields
semantics.interruption: stall, target envelope rejection, budget, or sustained gap rise returns control; no implicit retry
semantics.move_relative: world xyz_m displacement resolved once from measured segment entry pose
semantics.move_to_pose: absolute world xyz_m and optional absolute world quaternion_wxyz
semantics.observation_after: yield after this segment; pending segments do not autoplay or resume after intervention
semantics.preparation: uses current robot proprioception and known OSC conversion; no scene registration or calibration sweep
semantics.set_gripper: hold entry pose, apply command for at least the minimum, require stable measured gap; no grasp claim
semantics.wait: hold entry pose and command for max_steps, then return for observation

adaptations: LIBERO Panda grip_site world position and right_hand world orientation replace the DROID Robotiq flange frame.
Native 20 Hz OSC_POSE replaces the paper's 15 Hz per-step DLS joint-position controller.
Cartesian command errors are capped; no per-joint 0.05-rad increment or scene collision guarantee is provided.

agent_speedup_v2_geometry.HM_DIFF_GREY.derivation: hand motion mask: changed pixels differ by > 12 grey (v1 external_axes DIFF_THRESHOLD; the static scene differs by < 3); also the false-change and fingertip-band difference

agent_speedup_v2_geometry.HM_DILATE_PX.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_geometry.HM_FARNEBACK.derivation: Farneback parameters of v1 hand_image_motion (external_axes.py:51): pyramid scale, levels, window, iterations, poly_n, poly_sigma
agent_speedup_v2_geometry.HM_FARNEBACK.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_geometry.HM_MIN_FLOW_PX.derivation: hand motion mask: moving pixels flow > 1 px (v1 MIN_FLOW_PX)
agent_speedup_v2_geometry.HM_MIN_FLOW_PX.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_geometry.HM_MIN_PIXELS.derivation: hand motion mask: at least 50 moving changed pixels (v1 MIN_CHANGED_PIXELS)
agent_speedup_v2_geometry.HM_MIN_PIXELS.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_geometry.HM_TOP_FRACTIO.derivation: hand motion mask: the fastest decile of changed pixels is the hand (v1 TOP_FRACTION)
agent_speedup_v2_geometry.HM_TOP_FRACTIO.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_geometry.L1_FLOOR_PX.derivation: L1 hand locator consistency floor 3 px (spec §5.2 L1)
agent_speedup_v2_geometry.L1_FLOOR_PX.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_geometry.L1_MAX_ACROSS_.derivation: L1: a probe move locates the hand only when its image motion is within 30 deg of v_hat (moves across v_hat smear the hand band's centroid by up to half the motion: 8-16 px across error on the task-2 agentview y probes)
agent_speedup_v2_geometry.L1_MAX_ACROSS_.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_geometry.L1_MIN_ALONG_P.derivation: L1 precondition of fit and locate: the hand's image motion along v_hat must reach the tip band L1_TIP_BAND_PX (8 px), so the before and after fingertips are separate extremes (BG fix survey probe, 200 hovers x every step of a 3 cm vertical move: tip error median 35 px / max 143 px below 4 px of motion, max 122 px at 4-8 px, median 4.5-5.3 px / max 12 px from 8 px on; the 1-step pair of a probe leg moves 0.7-1.1 px; the 4 cm x probe of Calibrate+ moves 11 px)
agent_speedup_v2_geometry.L1_MIN_ALONG_P.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_geometry.L1_MIN_SAMPLES.derivation: L1: at least 3 located probe moves (two displacements) to validate the locator; with at most this many the consistency bound is the absolute sqrt 2 x L1_SIGMA_K x L1_FLOOR_PX = 12.7 px, and 2 agreeing locations fit flagged degraded (design review 1 decision §2.3 G-5, rulings item 5: the self-scaled bound accepted a 40 px fault in 15/15 cases, the absolute bound dropped it in 15/15 and kept clean data in 5/5)
agent_speedup_v2_geometry.L1_MIN_SAMPLES.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_geometry.L1_MODEL_SIGMA.derivation: L1 absolute model error of a located grip (radial rms against the evaluator grip projection, which the displacement-consistency sigma cannot see: it cancels a common offset): 5.4-5.5 px over 200 task-2 hover locations on a 3 cm vertical move (median 4.8-4.9 px, max 10 px; parts C and E 7-10 px), 3.3 px on the Calibrate+ moves; BG fix survey probe runs bgfix_*_001; re-derive at V5
agent_speedup_v2_geometry.L1_MODEL_SIGMA.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_geometry.L1_MOTION_AGRE.derivation: L1 locate: the measured hand motion replaces J dp only when its length agrees within 50 percent (and its direction within D14's 30 deg)
agent_speedup_v2_geometry.L1_MOTION_AGRE.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_geometry.L1_SIGMA_K.derivation: L1: displacement residuals within 3 sigma; also the mask dilation of refined region masks in units of the projector sigma (contract [C-51])
agent_speedup_v2_geometry.L1_SIGMA_K.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_geometry.L1_TIP_BAND_PX.derivation: L1: the fingertip pixel is the across-centroid of the outline pixels within 8 px of the extreme along v_hat, so both fingertips count (task-2 agentview, BG survey probe: with 3 px one finger was often alone in the band, 17 px across error; 6-10 px kept both)
agent_speedup_v2_geometry.L1_TIP_BAND_PX.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_geometry.MAD_TO_SIGMA.derivation: normal-consistency factor of the median absolute deviation (robust sigma)
agent_speedup_v2_geometry.MAD_TO_SIGMA.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_geometry.ORIENT_SMOOTH_.derivation: G-7 orientation_peak (design review 2 decision §2.2, §3; review-2 axis lens): the doubled-angle orientation histogram of 1 deg bins is circularly smoothed by a Gaussian of sigma 3 deg before its peak is taken; the peak is refined by the weighted mean within YAW_GRID_RAD / 2. Fitted on the two thin grip parts of task 2: re-derive on the cavity-edge and sliding-fixture regressions before M7
agent_speedup_v2_geometry.ORIENT_SMOOTH_.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_geometry.OUTLINE_SIDE_M.derivation: G-7 outline_orientation two_sided (design review 2 decision §2.2, axis lens mask_outline): at least 3 outline points whose tangent lies in the peak window on EACH side of the axis line. A behavioural minimum, not a shape test: a half-disk is two-sided (its arc runs parallel to the flat edge near its apex) and an aspect-1.25 rectangle passes the outline gate (T1 pins both; review-2 implementation review R-9)
agent_speedup_v2_geometry.OUTLINE_SIDE_M.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_geometry.OUTLINE_TANGEN.derivation: G-7 outline_orientation (decision §2.2, §3; axis lens mask_outline): the tangent at an outline point is the chord between the outline points 4 steps before and after it (about +-4 px), back-projected at the measured top and length-weighted; a contour of fewer than 3 x 4 points has no orientation
agent_speedup_v2_geometry.OUTLINE_TANGEN.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_geometry.PROJECTOR_AFFI.derivation: affine external projection error is about 20 percent of the predicted shift 15-30 cm from the anchor (contract [C-51] probe); re-anchor beyond that
agent_speedup_v2_geometry.PROJECTOR_AFFI.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_geometry.RAYLEIGH_MEDIA.derivation: rms / median of the norm of a 2-D isotropic Gaussian error (Rayleigh): 1 / sqrt(ln 2)
agent_speedup_v2_geometry.RAYLEIGH_MEDIA.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_geometry.REGION_CLOSE_P.derivation: region refinement: grooves and specular bands inside a region are closed by a 7 px disk (smaller than any region a part is registered from)
agent_speedup_v2_geometry.REGION_CLOSE_P.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_geometry.REGION_CORE_RA.derivation: region refinement: when the eroded affine mask is too small for a colour model, the core is the seed-centred disk of 12 px radius (about 450 px, a 21 px template's area)
agent_speedup_v2_geometry.REGION_CORE_RA.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_geometry.REGION_LAB_BIN.derivation: region refinement: the core's colour model is a Lab histogram of 6-unit bins (half the REGION_LAB_FLOOR radius, so the floor spans two bins)
agent_speedup_v2_geometry.REGION_LAB_BIN.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_geometry.REGION_LAB_FLO.derivation: region refinement: a pixel joins the region when its Lab colour (8-bit scaling [C-20]) lies within 12 of a colour of the region's core (12 = the O1 / v1 change floor)
agent_speedup_v2_geometry.REGION_LAB_FLO.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_geometry.REGION_MAX_ARE.derivation: region refinement: a refined area above 4 x the affine area is a flood and the affine mask is returned (refinement corrects the position, not the size; the BG review flood was 45 x)
agent_speedup_v2_geometry.REGION_MAX_ARE.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_geometry.REGION_MAX_MAR.derivation: region refinement: the affine mask grows (and the core erodes) by at most 48 px: a projector sigma of 50-57 px (the affine distance term far from the anchor, BG review: region B 0.37 m away) otherwise dilated it by 165 px and the region flooded 38 percent of the image; 48 px covers the measured affine errors (18-41 px for parts 27-29 cm from the start anchor, BG review locator probe)
agent_speedup_v2_geometry.REGION_MAX_MAR.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_geometry.REGION_MIN_ARE.derivation: region refinement: a refined area below 0.6 x the affine area is a partial capture (one tone of a two-tone region when a large sigma leaves only a seed core: 0.54 on the BG fix synthetic) and the affine mask is returned
agent_speedup_v2_geometry.REGION_MIN_ARE.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_geometry.REGION_MODE_FR.derivation: region refinement: a colour belongs to the core's model when at least 3 percent of the core lies within REGION_LAB_FLOOR of it: a ringed or two-tone region keeps every tone (BG fix, task-2 agentview region B: refined IoU 0.65-0.73 against 0.46-0.50 for a single median colour and 0.54 affine), while a 2-3 percent sliver of background in the core (an offset just beyond 3 sigma) does not join (1 percent flooded a synthetic textured background)
agent_speedup_v2_geometry.REGION_MODE_FR.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_geometry.REGION_MODE_RE.derivation: region refinement: a secondary colour also needs a tenth of the dominant colour's mass (BG fix: a seed on the shaded side of the fake slab's top face, an affine offset of 20 px, put the side into the model at 0.03 alone: IoU 0.77 against the top face, 0.81 with this; task-2 region B 0.65-0.70 against 0.48-0.57 affine)
agent_speedup_v2_geometry.REGION_MODE_RE.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_geometry.RELIEF_OFFSET_.derivation: spec §4.5 relief probes on the part's principal axes at +-(w/2 + 15 mm)
agent_speedup_v2_geometry.RELIEF_OFFSET_.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_geometry.RELIEF_SEARCH_.derivation: spec §4.5: the highest-contrast patch within +-8 px of a relief point
agent_speedup_v2_geometry.RELIEF_SEARCH_.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_geometry.RUNNING_KAPPA_.derivation: the search-window prediction uses a feature's running kappa only after 2 mm of measured in-plane motion (about 2 px at kappa 900 px/m; shorter baselines are tracking noise); before that the median running kappa
agent_speedup_v2_geometry.RUNNING_KAPPA_.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_geometry.SUBPIXEL_PINV.derivation: pseudo-inverse of the 3x3 quadratic peak design (v1 NCCTrack._QUADRATIC_PINV)
agent_speedup_v2_geometry.SUBPIXEL_PINV.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_geometry.V1_LOST_FRAMES.derivation: V1: a feature is lost after 2 consecutive misses (v1 Align LOST_FRAMES)
agent_speedup_v2_geometry.V1_LOST_FRAMES.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_geometry.V1_MIN_PEAK.derivation: V1: an NCC match below peak 0.6 is a miss (v1 NCCTrack min_peak, wrist_servo.py:129)
agent_speedup_v2_geometry.V1_MIN_PEAK.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_geometry.V1_PROBE_MIN_P.derivation: probe tracker V1: an NCC match below peak 0.9 is a miss (decision §3, §2.3 G-1): with dense seeds the task-2 thin grip part's band-top p90 error 12.4 -> 3.2 mm (a template straddling a depth step deforms under parallax and is dropped)
agent_speedup_v2_geometry.V1_PROBE_MIN_P.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_geometry.V3_HALF_PX.derivation: V3 re-acquisition search +-48 px around the prediction (spec §5.2 V3)
agent_speedup_v2_geometry.V3_HALF_PX.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_geometry.V3_MIN_PEAK.derivation: V3: re-acquired match peak >= 0.6 (spec §5.2 V3, v1 NCCTrack min_peak)
agent_speedup_v2_geometry.V3_MIN_PEAK.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_geometry.V3_SCALES.derivation: V3: extra template scales tried around the kappa ratio (v1 NCCTrack REACQUIRE_SCALES)
agent_speedup_v2_geometry.V3_SCALES.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_geometry.V3_SIGMA_K.derivation: V3: the re-acquired point lies within 3 sigma of the prediction (spec §5.2 V3)
agent_speedup_v2_geometry.V3_SIGMA_K.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_geometry.V5_TENSOR_HALF.derivation: structure tensor half size 12 px = 25 px patch (v1 BAR_CHECK_HALF_PX, wrist_servo.py:77)
agent_speedup_v2_geometry.V5_TENSOR_HALF.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_observers.EFFECT_OCCLUD.derivation: spec §4.10 effect_occluded: a frame with > 50 % of the region masked is skipped
agent_speedup_v2_observers.EFFECT_OCCLUD.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_observers.K1W_BLOCKED_E.derivation: spec §5.2 K1w: blocked if the late rate stayed >= 0.75 x the early rate
agent_speedup_v2_observers.K1W_BLOCKED_E.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_observers.K1W_BLOCKED_L.derivation: spec §5.2 K1w: blocked if late >= max(0.5 l w, 0.75 early) in the windows ending at the decision step and the step before; [F, SP] 0.5 l w ~ 0.16 mm/step
agent_speedup_v2_observers.K1W_BLOCKED_L.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_observers.K1W_DECIDE_ST.derivation: spec §5.2 K1w: a 12-step twist segment is decided at its 12th step (Appendix L 6); after a reversal the count starts at the first non-negative rate
agent_speedup_v2_observers.K1W_DECIDE_ST.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_observers.K1W_EXTEND_ST.derivation: spec §5.2 K1w: an undecided segment is extended to its 16th step, then the part rotation observer decides (contract §C8 [C-29])
agent_speedup_v2_observers.K1W_EXTEND_ST.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_observers.K1W_FALL_STAR.derivation: K1w after a reversal: the unwedge fall must begin by r_1 (one noisy non-negative reading at its start is tolerated); with no negative rate by then there is no fall and the window starts at r_0. [F, SP / CP] the falls start at r_0 (-0.092, -0.42 and -0.06 mm/step)
agent_speedup_v2_observers.K1W_FALL_STAR.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_observers.K1W_FIRST_RAT.derivation: spec §5.2 K1w / Appendix L 6: the early window of a fresh segment skips r_0, which carries the close and command transient (k0 = 1); [F, SP] r[1:5] gives the spec numbers 0.2605 / 0.065 / 0.227
agent_speedup_v2_observers.K1W_FIRST_RAT.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_observers.K1W_FREE_EARL.derivation: spec §5.2 K1w: free if the late rate fell to <= 0.25 x the early rate
agent_speedup_v2_observers.K1W_FREE_EARL.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_observers.K1W_FREE_LW.derivation: spec §5.2 K1w: free if late <= max(0.1 l w, 4 sigma_g, 0.25 early); [F, SP] 0.1 l w ~ 0.032 mm/step against a free late rate 0.045 and a blocked 0.445
agent_speedup_v2_observers.K1W_FREE_LW.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_observers.K1W_FREE_SIGM.derivation: spec §5.2 K1w: the 4 sigma_g gap-noise term of the free test
agent_speedup_v2_observers.K1W_FREE_SIGM.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_observers.K1W_MIN_LATE_.derivation: K1w stall guard: neither class unless the late window's mean hand yaw rate is >= 0.5 x the early window's (a stalled hand makes late -> 0 on a blocked part); spec K1w: the free late / early yaw ratio is 0.82-0.95, so the guard does not move the SP / CP verdicts; [F, real probe recording, review] a stalled blocked twist read 'free' at k = 11 without it
agent_speedup_v2_observers.K1W_MIN_LATE_.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_observers.K1W_UNWEDGE_P.derivation: [C-21] the post-reversal unwedge fall must end within ceil(1.5 x the reversed segment's steps); [F, SP] 13 unwedge steps after a 12-step blocked segment, a fall of ~0.33 mm/step
agent_speedup_v2_observers.K1W_UNWEDGE_P.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_observers.K1W_WINDOW.derivation: spec §5.2 K1w: early and late windows are 4 consecutive rates (Appendix L 6)
agent_speedup_v2_observers.K1W_WINDOW.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_observers.K4W_CONSECUTI.derivation: [C-30] K4w: the windows ending at two consecutive steps; [F, SP] fires 2-3 steps after the limit, within G4's 5
agent_speedup_v2_observers.K4W_CONSECUTI.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_observers.K4W_LW.derivation: spec §5.2 K4w: end stop when two consecutive 4-step windows reach max(0.5 l w, 5 x the median rate since the free classification)
agent_speedup_v2_observers.K4W_LW.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_observers.K4W_MEDIAN_K.derivation: spec §5.2 K4w: 5 x the median gap rate since the start; [F, SP] the steady rate was <= 0.004 mm/step, then 0.18 -> 0.49 mm/step at the limit
agent_speedup_v2_observers.K4W_MEDIAN_K.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_observers.K7_ANGLE_SPAN.derivation: K7 rotated-template search: +-4 deg around the last angle; K2 twists 0.1 rad commanded realize 1.1-1.3 deg per step
agent_speedup_v2_observers.K7_ANGLE_SPAN.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_observers.K7_ANGLE_STEP.derivation: K7 rotated-template search: 1 deg candidate step around the last angle, refined by a parabola
agent_speedup_v2_observers.K7_ANGLE_STEP.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_observers.K7_CONFIRM_FR.derivation: K7: a verdict needs the same class on 2 consecutive judged frames (V1 2-frame rule); [F, real probe recordings, review] single-frame flips at motion onsets
agent_speedup_v2_observers.K7_CONFIRM_FR.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_observers.K7_FLOOR_DEG.derivation: spec §5.2 K7: part rotation relative to the hand >= max(3 deg, 3 sigma_theta)
agent_speedup_v2_observers.K7_FLOOR_DEG.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_observers.K7_HYPOTHESIS.derivation: K7 span hypothesis test: the span-start patch matched in the current frame at 0 rotation (corotating) and at the span's hand yaw (blocked); the winner must lead by >= 0.4 x the template's own contrast between the two; [F, BO fix] 0.4 keeps every T1 fake verdict at the 12th step and gives 0 wrong free verdicts on the real grid (0.5 loses the free round fake at the 12th step, 0.3 adds wrong blocked frames)
agent_speedup_v2_observers.K7_HYPOTHESIS.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_observers.K7_HYPOTHESIS.derivation: K7 span hypothesis test: +-24 px translation search, the orbit of a blocked patch over a 6 deg span at <= 200 px from the axis (21 px)
agent_speedup_v2_observers.K7_HYPOTHESIS.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_observers.K7_LOST_FRAME.derivation: K7: two consecutive unmeasured frames make the part unmeasurable (V1 lost frames)
agent_speedup_v2_observers.K7_LOST_FRAME.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_observers.K7_MIN_COHERE.derivation: K7 structure-axis mode: coherence >= 0.5 for a usable axis (the D10 coherence floor)
agent_speedup_v2_observers.K7_MIN_COHERE.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_observers.K7_MIN_JITTER.derivation: K7: sigma_theta needs >= 3 second differences of the apparent rotation (taken after the bout's onset, so the lag build-up is not counted as jitter)
agent_speedup_v2_observers.K7_MIN_JITTER.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_observers.K7_MIN_PEAK.derivation: K7 rotated-template search: NCC peak >= 0.6 (v1 NCCTrack min_peak, V1)
agent_speedup_v2_observers.K7_MIN_PEAK.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_observers.K7_MIN_ROTATI.derivation: K7 rotation observability at start: the start template rotated by +-K7_FLOOR_DEG and re-matched with translation search must lose >= 0.005 NCC, else the patch is 'rotation_degenerate' (unmeasurable); [F, real task-2 wrist frames, BO fix] patches on the rotary part's smooth cap drop 0.0011-0.0031 and read 'corotating' when it is blocked; the T1 fakes' patches drop 0.006-0.08, the real ridge-edge patches 0.017-0.075
agent_speedup_v2_observers.K7_MIN_ROTATI.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_observers.K7_MIN_STD_GR.derivation: K7 patch texture: patch std >= 4 grey, the D15 / NCCTrack min_std, else the part is unmeasurable by template
agent_speedup_v2_observers.K7_MIN_STD_GR.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_observers.K7_ONSET_DEG.derivation: K7 onset allowance: a corotation span may start only after 4.5 deg of hand yaw in the current motion bout; [F, real steady free twist, BO fix] the free part lags the hand by 3.0 deg at 3.9 deg of yaw, 4.7 at 7.5, 5.6 at 11.0, 5.7 at 14.6 (SP: ~5.6 deg saturating), so a 6 deg span from 4.5 deg changes by < 2 deg; 4.5 deg keeps the first verdict at the 12th step of a 1.15 deg/step twist, where TwistSegment decides
agent_speedup_v2_observers.K7_ONSET_DEG.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_observers.K7_PATCH_RADI.derivation: K7 rotated-template search: template radius 20 px (41 px square) at the part patch, twice the FeatureTracker radius, so 3 deg of rotation move its edge by ~1 px; [F, robot-only real task-2 wrist frames, BO fix] steady free / paused / blocked twists over an 86-patch on-part grid: 0 wrong free verdicts at 16, 20 and 24 px; wrong blocked frames 2 / 131 judged (16 px, but 31 patches and the T1 round fake's disk patch unmeasurable), 9 / 168 (20 px, every T1 fake case decided at the 12th step), 22 / 213 (24 px)
agent_speedup_v2_observers.K7_PATCH_RADI.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_observers.K7_SEARCH_PX.derivation: K7 rotated-template search: +-12 px around the last match (the patch of a blocked part orbits the grip by ~1 px per degree at 60 px from it)
agent_speedup_v2_observers.K7_SEARCH_PX.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_observers.K7_SIGMA_K.derivation: spec §5.2 K7: the 3 sigma_theta term (measured jitter of the apparent rotation)
agent_speedup_v2_observers.K7_SIGMA_K.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_observers.K7_SLIP_LW.derivation: spec §5.2 K7: a slip is a gap fall <= -0.5 l w for >= 2 steps outside an expected unwedge
agent_speedup_v2_observers.K7_SLIP_LW.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_observers.K7_SLIP_SIGMA.derivation: K7 slip noise floor: the fall must also exceed 4 sigma_g (as K1w's free test), so a hand that yaws slowly (l w -> 0) does not read gap noise as a slip [C-8]
agent_speedup_v2_observers.K7_SLIP_SIGMA.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_observers.K7_SLIP_STEPS.derivation: spec §5.2 K7: the gap fall must last >= 2 steps
agent_speedup_v2_observers.K7_SLIP_STEPS.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_observers.K7_SPAN_FACTO.derivation: K7 part observable: corotation is judged over the trailing hand-yaw span of 2 x the K7 threshold, so a blocked part (apparent rotation = the span) and a corotating one (~0) lie on either side of the threshold; [F, SP] a free part lags the hand by a pad compliance of ~5.6 deg that saturates (gap excess 1.7 mm at 14 mm/rad), so the rotation since the start is not the test
agent_speedup_v2_observers.K7_SPAN_FACTO.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_observers.K7_STILL_DEG_.derivation: K7 motion bout: a step with < 0.25 deg of hand yaw (a quarter of K2's realized 1.1-1.3 deg/step) ends the bout; [F, real probe recording, review] the part caught up ~3 deg while the hand yawed < 0.3 deg/step and the lag re-developed at the next motion onset
agent_speedup_v2_observers.K7_STILL_DEG_.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_observers.K9_FLOOR_DEG.derivation: spec §5.2 K9: no spring-back if the part changes <= max(3 deg, 3 mm, 3 sigma) over 10 frames after release
agent_speedup_v2_observers.K9_FLOOR_DEG.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_observers.K9_FLOOR_M.derivation: spec §5.2 K9: the 3 mm position floor
agent_speedup_v2_observers.K9_FLOOR_M.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_observers.LAB_AB_OFFSET.derivation: [C-20] OpenCV 8-bit Lab scaling: a + 128, b + 128 (geometry LAB_AB_OFFSET, restated)

agent_speedup_v2_scene.SUPPORT_MIN_CONTR.derivation: a parallax support plane is accepted when its photometric cost is >= 20 % below the sweep median (a support with texture to measure)
agent_speedup_v2_scene.SUPPORT_MIN_CONTR.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_scene.SUPPORT_RING_M.derivation: spec §4.5 step 3 annulus around the region: 15 mm, the relief-probe offset of spec §4.5 item 2
agent_speedup_v2_scene.SUPPORT_RING_M.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_scene.SUPPORT_SWEEP_M.derivation: support-plane parallax sweep: 0.5 m below the fingertips; R14 puts the start grip 0.2655 m above the R13 mount base, which stands on its support, so 0.5 m reaches supports down to ~0.23 m below the mount base
agent_speedup_v2_scene.SUPPORT_SWEEP_M.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_scene.SUPPORT_SWEEP_STE.derivation: coarse support sweep step: one 5 mm HeightField cell
agent_speedup_v2_scene.SUPPORT_SWEEP_STE.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_scene.SWEEP_DISC_SIDES.derivation: S-16' local rule (BSBP amendment): a hull vertex's own 2 sigma margin is drawn as the circumscribed 16-gon of that radius (never inside the disc; 2 % radial excess)
agent_speedup_v2_scene.SWEEP_DISC_SIDES.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_scene.SWEEP_STEP_RAD.derivation: hand-swept mask: footprints every 5 deg, consecutive hulls joined (corner chord 9.5 mm at the 108.7 mm R7 footprint corner radius, inside the joined hull)
agent_speedup_v2_scene.SWEEP_STEP_RAD.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_scene.SWEPT_DILATE_PX.derivation: hand-swept mask dilation default = O1_HAND_DILATE_PX: a 9 px square kernel (4 px per side), the v1 hand_image_motion dilation (external_axes.py:53), restated
agent_speedup_v2_scene.SWEPT_DILATE_PX.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_scene.TOP_BAND_SIGMA_K.derivation: decision §2.2 S-1 / §3: band half-width b = max(D8_FLOOR_M, 2 x the median sample sigma); the top band's lower edge in S-6 is top - max(D8_FLOOR_M, 2 sigma_h) (loop lens ablation: floor 3 mm, k 2)
agent_speedup_v2_scene.TOP_BAND_SIGMA_K.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_scene.TOP_BAND_SUPPORT_.derivation: decision §2.2 S-3 / §3: a top band of >= 10 members takes TOP_MODEL_M, fewer TOP_MODEL_THIN_M (loop lens: n < 10 -> p90 4.5 mm, max 13.3 mm); also the band size of the region_too_small hull fallback (S-4')
agent_speedup_v2_scene.TOP_BAND_SUPPORT_.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_scene.TOP_GATE_M.derivation: decision §2.2 S-2 / §3: only samples with sigma_z <= 2 mm enter the top band (loop lens sigma_z gate)
agent_speedup_v2_scene.TOP_GATE_M.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_scene.TOP_MODEL_M.derivation: decision §2.2 S-3 / §3, ruling 4b: the part-level model term of the top's sigma_h when the band has >= TOP_BAND_SUPPORT_N members, 3 mm (remedy 1 E2: thin part 2 sigma coverage 0.979, 3 sigma 1.000, P6 pass 1.00, other parts 1.000; judge live sigma_h 3.0 mm); it enters sigma_h only, never a D8 band or the region growth; re-derive at V5
agent_speedup_v2_scene.TOP_MODEL_M.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_scene.TOP_MODEL_THIN_M.derivation: decision §2.2 S-3 / §3: the model term when the band has fewer than TOP_BAND_SUPPORT_N members, 5 mm (remedy 1 E2: 3 sigma coverage 1.000 and below the 5.54 mm P6 limit; judge live sigma_h 5.0-5.1 mm)
agent_speedup_v2_scene.TOP_MODEL_THIN_M.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_scene.TOP_PERCENTILE.derivation: spec §4.5 registration step 4: top_z = the 95th percentile of the region heights (inverse-variance weighted; taken as the median of the samples within the D8 band of that percentile, sigma = max(their median sigma, their robust scatter))
agent_speedup_v2_scene.TOP_PERCENTILE.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_scene.TOP_WINDOW_PX.derivation: decision §2.2 S-2 / §3 (= geometry FT_DENSE_WINDOW_PX): a point seed's top band takes the samples projecting within 40 px of the seed in the seed's pose (~1.2-2 cm at hover depth, the probe tracker's dense lattice window; loop lens and remedy 1 E2)
agent_speedup_v2_scene.TOP_WINDOW_PX.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_scene.TRACK_SIGMA_PX.derivation: image localization noise 1.5 px = v1 PIXEL_NOISE_PX (wrist_servo.py:33)
agent_speedup_v2_scene.TRACK_SIGMA_PX.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_scene.UNCONFIRMED_MIN_G.derivation: grip-part lens BS-2: an unconfirmed cell is confirmed by a LATER sample within D8, i.e. agreeing samples of >= 2 measurement groups (absorbed surveys; a sample of no survey is a group of its own step): one probe's dense lattice is one group
agent_speedup_v2_scene.UNCONFIRMED_MIN_G.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_scene.UNCONFIRMED_MIN_N.derivation: grip-part lens BS-2: a single measured cell above every known 8-neighbour by more than the D8 tolerance is unconfirmed only with >= 3 known neighbours (a border or a sparse cell is no isolated spike)
agent_speedup_v2_scene.UNCONFIRMED_MIN_N.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_scene.W_MODEL_M.derivation: lead decision F1 (Wave 2 entry gate): the part-level model term of every width sigma, sigma_w = hypot(pixel sigma_w, W_MODEL_M), on the pattern of TOP_MODEL_M (147 unique C hovers: width RMS 2.42 mm vs median pixel sigma_w 1.48 mm; offline on 21 current-code survey sets 1.5 mm gives C 0 false G13+ trips and e2 >= 0.947 in every set of >= 10 hovers; the hinged fixture part A, reported only, keeps 15 trips over those sets, 2.0 mm would clear them). It enters sigma_w only, never a width value, the narrowest-width choice, the S-13 collapse test or the region growth; re-derive at V5
agent_speedup_v2_scene.W_MODEL_M.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_thresholds.STRUCTURAL_F.label: DD

S-4' accepts a D10 axis, and P-C a width-harmonic jaw, only when the image or mask tensor axis and the region-cell PCA axis agree within it; §1.3 axis consensus test: kept all 14 axes with error <= 7.3 deg and refused all 5 with error 10.5-76.5 deg. Design review 2 decision §3 (no new number): the D10-OE outline / edge agreement (S-11) and the S-12 view agreement; judge live: with S-12 the gate set accepted 20/20 and 17/20 grip-part axes with 0 beyond 7.5 deg
agent_speedup_v2_types.AXIS_AGREE_MAX_RA.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_types.EVIDENCE_TEXT_MAX.derivation: spec §3.7 evidence rule: executor-written evidence text is at most 200 characters
agent_speedup_v2_types.EVIDENCE_TEXT_MAX.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_types.HF_DISAGREE_SIGMA.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_types.HF_HALF_EXTENT_M.derivation: covers the R13 full stretch 0.804 m minus the R14 start offset 0.454 m = 0.35 m around the start grip, plus 0.15 m
agent_speedup_v2_types.HF_HALF_EXTENT_M.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_types.HF_RANK.derivation: spec §4.5 depth authority: touch 4 > kappa = loom 3 > dense 2 > the D7a plane and D7b obstacle fills 1 > none 0; fills rank below every measurement [C-33]
agent_speedup_v2_types.HF_RANK.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_types.POLY_IOU_MIN_CELL.derivation: poly_iou resolves at least 40 raster cells across the larger side of the union bounding box (IoU error of order 1/40 for compact polygons, so parts smaller than a 5 mm HeightField cell are still compared); larger polygons keep the 5 mm cell
agent_speedup_v2_types.POLY_IOU_MIN_CELL.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_types.POLY_MITRE_MAX_RA.derivation: poly_inflate corners: each convex corner is closed by tangent pieces of at most 90 deg, so every side moves out by exactly the margin whatever the world yaw, and no point lies farther than sqrt 2 x the margin from the polygon (a rectangle corner is one piece: its offset is exact)
agent_speedup_v2_types.POLY_MITRE_MAX_RA.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_types.PREVIOUS_REJECTED.derivation: §C4.7 PointNeed.previous_rejected: the measured reason sent with a re-point is at most 120 characters
agent_speedup_v2_types.PREVIOUS_REJECTED.label: DD

agent_speedup_v2_types.QUARTER_TURN_COUN.derivation: frame alignment: k counter-clockwise quarter turns, k in 0..3 (mark_prompting rotate_quarter; a full turn is four quarter turns)

agent_speedup_v2_types.RIM_WALL_RADIUS_F.derivation: the rim rule needs a thin wall: the measured radial cross-section <= 0.5 r (moved from the planner, gap round: the planner's rim rule and the scene's annulus model MC-R2b read the same bound)

semantics.approach: world xyz_m displacement from measured entry, contact profile; stall is not a contact certificate
semantics.completion: only measured pose arrival or measured gap stability; object/task success remains unknown
semantics.continuation: submit a new execution from the current observation; relative targets use new measured entry poses
semantics.gripper: motion keeps the actual command; use separate set_gripper with null pose fields
semantics.interruption: stall, target envelope rejection, budget, or sustained gap rise returns control; no implicit retry
semantics.move_relative: world xyz_m displacement resolved once from measured segment entry pose
semantics.move_to_pose: absolute world xyz_m and optional absolute world quaternion_wxyz
semantics.observation_after: yield after this segment; pending segments do not autoplay or resume after intervention
semantics.preparation: uses current robot proprioception and known OSC conversion; no scene registration or calibration sweep
semantics.set_gripper: hold entry pose, apply command for at least the minimum, require stable measured gap; no grasp claim
semantics.wait: hold entry pose and command for max_steps, then return for observation
